ache.title: Five minutes a day, every day, forever
ache.note: A five-minute Aether Gazer routine: stamina packs, Sigil Spirit Capture, supply runs, the Joint Defense Agreement. Five minutes sounds small, and that’s the point. Dailies are a chore made to feel tiny so it becomes a habit, and the habit is what brings you back to the banners. Skipping a day is allowed.
watch: stamina packs that nag to be used
a routine that keeps you returning
ache.tip: Skip dailies one day a week on purpose. If the game feels like a chore without them, notice that.
lines: five minutes a day is a habit, not a hobby
skip a day. the game won’t cry. I might

textData.text: Join me as I walk you through how to optimize your daily routine in AetherGazer. Learn step-by-step instructions on redeeming stamina packs, completing Sigil Spirit Capture and supply runs, and tackling the Joint Defense Agreement. Get tips on efficient team setups and essential daily tasks to maximize your rewards and improve your character builds. From leveling up characters to handling sigils and functors, this guide covers everything you need to know to efficiently play AetherGazer in just five minutes each day.
